cluster.Description:
Identifies the alloydb cluster. Must be in the format
'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}'

database_roles.Description: List of database roles this database user has.

name.Description: Name of the resource in the form of projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster}/users/{user}.

user_id.Description: The database role name of the user.

user_type.Description: The type of this user. Possible values: ["ALLOYDB_BUILT_IN", "ALLOYDB_IAM_USER"]
